main.summary: Supports querying Tag records in the Catalog.

property.name: CatalogPageSize
property.summary: Maximum records to return on this page. Omitted values use the server default; valid values are 1 through 100.

property.name: CatalogPageToken
property.summary: Opaque token from the previous page. Reuse it with the same filters to continue.

property.name: IDs
property.summary: Distinct matching item IDs in page order.

property.name: NextCatalogPageToken
property.summary: Opaque token to request the next page, or null when no page remains.
